title: Spicy Beef Paella
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on the classic Spanish dish, featuring beef and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomato, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, chicken broth, and browned beef and sausage to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is tender.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot.
